Endo-type nylon oligomer hydrolase from Paenarthrobacter sp. KI72 (pOAD2 plasmid, nylC gene); autocatalytically processed into alpha/beta subunits forming a doughnut-shaped tetramer (Negoro et al., PDB 5XYG). Engineered thermostabilized variants span a documented ~47C range, indicating substantial engineerable thermostability (relevant future mutation-module target). T_opt/pH_opt for the wild type are literature-approximate (demo assumption). Sequence pending UniProt fetch. No single canonical UniProt accession was confirmed while assembling this MVP package — GenBank/literature reference only. pH_opt/T_opt are literature-approximate (demo assumption; mesophilic Pseudomonas source).
